dataset_metadata.name: The Dataset for: Real-time personalized health status prediction of lithium-ion batteries using deep transfer learning
dataset_metadata.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
dataset_metadata.citation: Yuan, Ye; Ma, Guijun; Xu, Songpei (2022), "The Dataset for: Real-time personalized health status prediction of lithium-ion batteries using deep transfer learning", Mendeley Data, V2, doi: 10.17632/nsc7hnsg4s.2
dataset_metadata.funding: National Key R&D Program of China (Grant 2018YFB1701202); National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant 92167201)

aging_modes.notes: 77 cells each cycled with a unique multi-stage discharge protocol; identical fast-charging protocol applied to all cells. 55 cells used for training, 22 for testing. 3 of 80 originally prepared cells excluded due to sudden faults before degradation failure. Total of 146,122 discharge cycles recorded across all cells.

time_protocol.notes: Cycle lives range from 1100 to 2700 cycles (average 1898, std 387). Rest time between arbitrary discharge steps was 30 s. Cells cycled until maximum capacity first reached 80% of nominal capacity.

notes: Charge protocol (identical for all cells): CC at 5C from 0% to 80% SOC, then CC at 1C from 80% SOC to 3.6 V, then CV at 3.6 V until 100% SOC with a current cutoff of C/20. Discharge protocol (unique per cell): 4-step multi-stage CC from 100% to 0% SOC with voltage cutoff of 2 V; the first three steps discharge from 100%→60%, 60%→40%, 40%→20% SOC at variable C-rates drawn from {1C, 2C, 3C, 4C, 5C}; the last step always discharges from 20%→0% SOC at 1C. Example protocol: 5C-4C-3C-1C. The paper also references two external public datasets used for transfer learning validation: the Severson et al. (Nat. Energy, 2019) LFP dataset and the Preger et al. (J. Electrochem. Soc., 2020) NMC/graphite dataset, which are NOT part of this deposit.
